targets.subject: RoboRide expansion — following up on last week's outreach
targets.message: Linda — following up on the note I sent last week. The RoboRide price drop and residential expansion that came out this week is exactly the market shift I have been modeling since early in the year. I flagged this trajectory internally before I left the branch, and I built scenario projections showing what a 30-50% auto loan origination decline looks like for community financial institutions over 18 months. I am sharing that framing not to relitigate my old job but because I think it is useful context for anyone in regional financial services right now. If you know of any lending, underwriting, or risk advisory roles at credit unions, community banks, or insurance-adjacent finance organizations in the region, I would value the conversation. I can send the scenario work as background if that helps. I am also finishing a commercial and small business lending certification — roughly six months from completion — and my focus is positioning toward small-dollar lending and community business credit. That is where I think the demand is going. Let me know if there is anyone worth a conversation.

relationship_effect.notes: David following up on tick 7 outreach with a timely, market-grounded reason to re-engage. Offers concrete analytical work product. Frames himself as capable and forward-looking rather than distressed. Reinforces the value of the relationship for Linda as a professional contact who reads markets accurately.

targets.subject: How did the first session go?
targets.message: Kevin — wanted to check in after your first Community Center office hours. Not as your former manager — that chapter is closed and you know it. Just as someone who backed the idea and wants to know what you are actually seeing in that room. Who showed up? What are people asking about? I am curious about the small business side specifically — the diner owners, the service shops, anyone who is trying to figure out whether they can access credit to adapt. That is the market I think is opening up right now, and you are closer to it than anyone I know. Also — the RoboRide expansion this week is the scenario I modeled at 50% origination decline. If your NMLS pathway is still moving, I would keep pushing on that. The auto side is not coming back.

relationship_effect.notes: David maintaining the peer relationship rather than the supervisory one. Asking about Kevin's work demonstrates genuine interest and sustains the highest-trust relationship David has. The market context reinforces that David is paying attention and sharing useful information. Requesting ground-level intelligence signals David values what Kevin is learning, not just what Kevin can do for him institutionally.
